steps.title: Create milestones, labels, issue templates, project board
steps.notes: Verified live on GitHub after the Sync Project Planning workflow completed successfully on 2026-03-30.

steps.title: Open tracked epics as the roadmap grows
steps.notes: The original Stage 0 epic seed set is live on GitHub; newly added Phase 3B epic seeds are now present in the in-repo manifest and require the next planning-sync run.

steps.title: Open first issue seed set
steps.notes: The original Stage 0 issue seed set is live on GitHub; newly added Phase 3B issue seeds are now present in the in-repo manifest and require the next planning-sync run.

steps.title: Write and merge ADR-001 through ADR-007
Scaffold docs/adr, tests/spectra, and issue-template directories
Create full fluxforge package structure
steps.notes: This scaffold exists, but the roadmap does not formally advance to Phase 1 until Stage 0 is fully satisfied.

steps.title: Implement PluginRegistry base and all 6 registry instances
steps.notes: Implemented additively, but not counted as the formal next roadmap step until Stage 0 is closed.

steps.title: Implement MainWindow with dockable zones A-F
steps.notes: The Qt shell now implements the six logical zones, QDockWidget layout, toolbar/menu/status surfaces, and QSettings layout save/restore.

steps.title: Implement ModeManager with Simple/Expert/Standards
steps.notes: Mode state now supports Simple/Expert/Standards, standards locking, theme selection, and persistence through a settings backend.

steps.title: Implement SelectionBus singleton
steps.notes: SelectionBus now provides shared singleton state, helper publishers, and shell-level wiring across the canvas, sidebar, log, and inspector.

steps.title: Implement SpectrumCanvas abstraction and PyQtGraph backend
steps.notes: The abstraction now includes shared renderer-side data structures and an import-safe PyQtGraph production backend.

steps.title: Add Vispy backend stub
steps.notes: The Vispy renderer remains a non-default additive stub, which is the required Phase 1 deliverable.

steps.title: Implement HierarchicalSpectrumBuffer
steps.notes: The shared spectrum buffer now pre-computes multi-resolution levels for the primary canvas backend.

steps.title: Implement MCADevice base class and mock device
steps.notes: The HAL layer now includes a device registry, mock-device snapshot support, and spectrum/session metadata wiring for `source_type`, `device_id`, and `device_label`.

steps.title: Implement Spectrum dataclass + .ffs session file read/write
steps.notes: GammaSpectrum now carries the required source/GPS metadata and `.ffs` sessions round-trip through the new `FluxForgeSession` model.

steps.title: Implement reader factory + N42 / CHN / SPC / CNF / SPE / CSV readers
steps.notes: The Phase 1 factory now dispatches N42, CHN, SPC, CNF, SPE, and CSV spectra, and the modern shell has recent-file plus drag/drop open-path handling.

steps.title: Implement N42.42 (2012) export writer with XSD schema validation
steps.notes: The writer now emits the RadInstrumentData-based 2012 path and validates exports with lxml against the bundled schema.

steps.title: Build nuclide DB SQLite schema including decay_chains table
steps.notes: The new SQLite builder creates `nuclides`, `gamma_lines`, and `decay_chains` tables plus an FTS5-backed `nuclide_search` index when the local SQLite build supports it.

steps.title: Implement Nuclide Search panel with instant reference line overlay
steps.notes: The sidebar now has search-as-you-type nuclide lookup backed by the SQLite library, and the selection bus carries reference-line overlays straight to the canvas.

steps.title: Implement QA & Standards section in left sidebar
steps.notes: The redesigned shell now reserves a dedicated QA & Standards section in the left sidebar with always-visible roadmap guidance.

steps.title: Reserve Dashboard tab in Zone C
steps.notes: The central workspace now reserves a permanent Dashboard tab for the digital-twin roadmap.

steps.title: Add hardware LED in the status bar
steps.notes: The main window now carries a dedicated hardware LED widget in the status bar, and clicking it opens the Dashboard tab for direct access.

steps.title: Implement dark/light theme + system-theme detection
steps.notes: Theme resolution now supports dark, light, and system modes with dedicated QSS assets.

steps.title: Add test harness with sample spectra, CI baseline, regression snapshots
steps.notes: The repo now contains sample-spectrum scaffolding, targeted I/O regression tests, and CI coverage for the Phase 1 foundation.

steps.title: Implement unified energy + FWHM calibration dialog (bGamma-style)
steps.notes: The redesigned Qt shell now exposes the unified calibration workspace with embedded spectrum review, live energy/FWHM fits, ASTM E181 order locking, and residual-first diagnostics.

steps.title: Add quick slider calibration mode (PeakEasy-inspired)
steps.notes: The modern Qt calibration workspace now includes additive quick-slider anchor controls, shell launch points, and native review coverage.

steps.title: Add non-linear deviation pairs (InterSpec-style)
steps.notes: Deviation-pair fine tuning is now available in the calibration dialog and persists through the spectrum calibration path.

steps.title: Implement ROI drag + real-time Gaussian peak fitting
steps.notes: The spectrum canvas now exposes a draggable ROI with live fit overlays, ROI residuals, and calibration-table application actions.

steps.title: Implement skew model fitter; register all fitters in fitter_registry
steps.notes: The shared peak fitter registry now includes the recommended Gaussian fitter and the additive skewed-Gaussian fitter.

steps.title: Implement MethodSelectorWidget and wire to fitter_registry
steps.notes: The reusable method selector now drives the ROI fitter selection from the shared registry and respects Standards mode locking.

steps.title: Implement undo/redo via QUndoStack for all peak operations
steps.notes: The modern Qt shell now routes peak-table mutations through a shared QUndoStack-backed workspace-state command path.

steps.title: Implement Peak Table with CMV synchronization via SelectionBus
steps.notes: The bottom peak table is now live in the Qt shell with status dots, candidate columns, selection synchronization, pinning, and tagging.

steps.title: Implement auto peak search (Ctrl+A) with review dialog
steps.notes: Ctrl+A now opens an auto-peak review flow in the modern Qt stack before committing detected peaks to the shared table.

steps.title: Implement Bayesian library matching and register it in the id registry
steps.notes: A Bayesian line-matching engine is now registered and wired into the peak workflow for multi-line nuclide ranking.

steps.title: Implement efficiency calibration dialog with registered models
steps.notes: The redesigned Qt stack now ships a dedicated efficiency dialog with four registered model families and activity-panel integration.

steps.title: Implement activity calculation with uncertainty propagation
steps.notes: The Activity Results panel now computes activities from selected peaks using the active efficiency fit and propagated counting uncertainty.

steps.title: Implement source age correction and Bateman equation support
steps.notes: The activity workflow now exposes source-age correction and Bateman-based decay-chain summaries in the modern Qt path.

steps.title: Implement background subtraction (simple / scaled / statistical)
steps.notes: Foreground/background subtraction is now configurable from the Activity panel and reflected in the central spectrum canvas.

steps.title: Implement mini residual sub-plots on the canvas
steps.notes: The PyQtGraph canvas now shows a residual strip for the active peaks in Expert and Standards modes.

steps.title: Implement GPS extraction and Survey Map panel
steps.notes: GPS metadata extraction is now surfaced through the dedicated Survey Map panel in the modern bottom workspace.

steps.title: Add multi-spectrum tabs above the canvas
steps.notes: Foreground, Background, and Secondary Overlay tabs now sit above the central canvas in the redesigned Qt shell.

steps.title: Implement pinned nuclides and nuclide tagging
steps.notes: Pinned nuclides now persist in the shared workspace state and peaks can be tagged directly from the live Qt table.

steps.title: Implement cascade sum line display
steps.notes: Pinned nuclides now drive dotted cascade-sum overlays on the modern PyQtGraph canvas.

steps.title: Implement Bayesian peak fitting and register it in fitter_registry
steps.notes: The ROI fitter registry now includes a Bayesian Gaussian option regularized by the active FWHM calibration.

steps.title: Implement interactive peak isotope assignment and reassignment in the modern GUI
steps.notes: The Peak Table now exposes an undoable manual isotope assignment and clear/reassign path that remains available after Bayesian matching.

steps.title: Implement centroid-driven isotope browser with adjustable energy window and active-library filtering
steps.notes: The Peak ID Browser now starts from the selected centroid or a typed energy, defaults to ±2 keV, and filters candidate lines through the active gamma-identification source.

steps.title: Implement gamma-phenomena estimation overlays for continuum, Compton features, and escape peaks
steps.notes: The selected line now drives estimated Compton edge, backscatter, annihilation, and escape-peak guides that are listed in the panel and overlaid on the spectrum canvas.

steps.title: Keep peak IDs editable after automated workflows and wire the edit path through SelectionBus and undo/redo
steps.notes: Manual overrides, clear actions, SelectionBus guide overlays, and QUndoStack-backed reassignment all remain available after automated peak-ID workflows.

steps.title: Implement GRAVEL in unfolding/gravel.py and register it
steps.notes: The dedicated Phase 3 unfolding package now exposes the GRAVEL method through a shared UnfoldingMethod contract, registers it in the plugin registry, carries shared pyunfold-style nonnegative input validation, and now includes external-reference parity regression coverage against the local Neutron-Unfolding and pyunfold repos on matched methods, datasets, and tolerance settings.

steps.title: Implement MAXED in unfolding/maxed.py and register it
steps.notes: MAXED is now implemented in the dedicated unfolding package, registered beside GRAVEL in the shared unfolder registry, and covered by the FluxForge pytest workflow and registry tests with uncertainty reporting.

steps.title: Implement RMLE in unfolding/rmle.py and register as default in unfold_registry
steps.notes: RMLE is now implemented in the dedicated unfolding package, registered as the recommended default in the shared unfolder registry, exposed in the modern Qt unfolding workspace, and selectable through the public CLI and SpectrumUnfolder workflow.

steps.title: Implement ML seed in unfolding/ml_seed.py and register in unfold_registry
steps.notes: ML Seed now exists as a registry-backed unfolder, is selectable in the CLI, SpectrumUnfolder, and Qt workspace, and can initialize both GRAVEL and RMLE through a confidence-threshold gate.

steps.title: Build unfolding dialog with algorithm comparison mode
steps.notes: The redesigned Qt shell now includes an unfolding workspace with registry-backed method selectors, an RMLE lambda slider, response-matrix heatmap, convergence plot, uncertainty-aware flux table, ML Seed controls, and mouse-driven GRAVEL/MAXED/RMLE/ML Seed comparison mode.

steps.title: Implement ML peak analysis engine (PyTorch → ONNX)
steps.notes: The Qt shell now exposes an ONNX-oriented ML peak proposal engine with a CPU fallback backend, registry registration, and explicit peak-table GUI coverage.

steps.title: Implement ASTM E181 compliance module and register in standards_registry
steps.notes: ASTM E181 is now registered in the standards registry with residual-band and locked-order checks.

steps.title: Implement ASTM E1297 MDA module and register in standards_registry
steps.notes: ASTM E1297 now uses a locked Currie MDA implementation and is covered in the backend tests.

steps.title: Implement ASTM E1218 + C1232 modules
steps.notes: ASTM E1218 calibration bracketing and ASTM C1232 QA drift checks are now registered and covered.

steps.title: Implement ASTM C1030 Pu isotopics wizard
steps.notes: The C1030 isotopics backend and four-step Expert/Standards wizard are now available in the modern Qt shell.

steps.title: Implement QA monitor and Tools → QA History view
steps.notes: SQLite-backed QA history, drift summaries, CSV export, the Tools → QA History dialog, and the direct Run ASTM Check review surface are now implemented in the modern shell.

steps.title: Implement Standards Mode workflow locking via registry
steps.notes: Standards registry entries now expose lock metadata, the shell surfaces padlock summaries, and Standards mode keeps the active lock set visible in the modern GUI.

steps.title: Implement Jinja2 report engine and 3 bundled templates
steps.notes: The report engine now renders bundled standard-lab, ASTM-compliance, and batch-summary templates and is reachable through the Qt report dialog with both HTML and PDF export paths.

steps.title: Implement batch analysis queue and ProcessPoolExecutor workers
steps.notes: The bottom-shell Batch Queue tab now runs ProcessPoolExecutor-backed analyses, exposes visible progress in the Qt shell, and writes per-spectrum JSON plus an aggregate CSV.

steps.title: Add GPU-accelerated batch inference via optional CuPy
steps.notes: Optional CuPy backend selection now exists for ML and batch workflows, with a clean NumPy fallback on CPU-only environments.

steps.title: Implement peak-search, background, and ROI parity
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Registry-backed Mariscotti/second-difference/NASA peak-search selection, explicit ROI sideband/SNIP background workflows, overlap decomposition, ROI statistics, modern Qt ROI Tools workspace, and matching CLI commands are now implemented and tested.

steps.title: Implement calibration and efficiency parity workflows
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Extends detector-slot workflows, preserves all four GSA efficiency models as first-class methods, and adds NASA/InterSpec-style calibration preserve, multi-file, and fine-tune flows.

steps.title: Implement identification, activity, and reference parity
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds editable text libraries, richer energy-window search, reference overlays, relative activity, source-age/decay-chain context, pinned mixtures, and expanded line-family libraries.

steps.title: Implement operational calculator parity
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds detection-limit, dose, shielding/source-fit, attenuation/material, units-conversion, and offline reporting calculators using registry-backed method selection.

steps.title: Implement archive, batch, and k0 parity workflows
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds InterSpec-style file query and batch compare, GSA ROI-statistics review workflows, and KayWin-derived k0/NAA session/report flows without entering hardware-control scope.

steps.title: Curate repo-backed parity fixtures and manifests
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Defines the `tests/spectra/reference_parity/` fixture families and per-case manifests with source repo, source case, workflow, expected outputs, tolerances, and provenance notes.

steps.title: Add algorithm-level parity tests
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds parser, calibration, peak-search, fit, activity, detection-limit, dose/shielding, and k0 parity checks against curated fixtures.

steps.title: Add workflow-level parity tests
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds end-to-end same-input, same-workflow, nearly-same-result validation suites for each source family with golden outputs and declared tolerances.

steps.title: Implement direct-manipulation canvas parity
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Copies the GSA-v4 and InterSpec interaction model: right-click peak add/delete/move, ROI edge dragging, background handles, peak-label toggles, and explicit overlay-role actions.

steps.title: Implement new parity workspaces in the modern Qt shell
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds ROI Statistics, Detection Limit, Dose/Shielding, Relative Activity, File Query/Batch Compare, Reference/Library Workbench, and k0 characterization/report workspaces in the modern Qt shell only.

steps.title: Implement GUI polish parity, first-class dark mode, and saved themes
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Adds InterSpec-style role-aware overlay polish, a shipped dark theme, saved theme profiles, clearer launch points, and tighter graph-table synchronization.

steps.title: Add GUI verification, artifact review, and release checklist
steps.secondary_reference: FluxForge_Additions_v3_Final.md §19 / Phase 3B + Appendix — Offline Spectroscopy Parity Crosswalk
steps.notes: Extends the Qt workflow-test, native-probe, artifact-gallery, and acceptance-checklist pattern across every new offline-parity GUI surface.

steps.title: Implement USB HID + Ethernet HAL drivers
steps.notes: HAL driver work remains on the roadmap, but it is formally deferred until the new Phase 3B offline spectroscopy parity module closes.

steps.title: Implement device discovery + thumbnails
steps.notes: The Dashboard and Devices surfaces are still reserved placeholders waiting on real HAL discovery.

steps.title: Implement Digital Twin dashboard
steps.notes: The Dashboard tab is still reserved, but its live telemetry implementation remains a later Phase 4 item.

steps.title: Implement Spectrogram panel
steps.notes: The Spectrogram tab remains reserved until live acquisition and time-energy data streams land.

steps.title: Implement ROI count-rate ETA forecasting
steps.notes: The Dashboard, sidebar, and status bar now estimate time-to-target counts for the active ROI using current count rate plus loaded-spectrum history.

steps.title: Implement dead-time saturation forecasting
steps.notes: Dead-time history from loaded spectra is now trended in the Qt dashboard, with projected one-hour dead time and saturation warnings.

steps.title: Implement QA-history recalibration forecasting
steps.notes: QA slope analysis now predicts the next recalibration trigger date and surfaces it in the predictive dashboard, QA sidebar, and status bar.

steps.title: Implement a saved-list nuclide workbench in the modern sidebar
steps.notes: The modern sidebar now lets analysts save and clear user-defined nuclide lists and re-apply them as one combined overlay without leaving the Qt shell.

steps.title: Implement parent/daughter, age-aware line, specific-activity, and dose context in the GUI reference workflow
steps.notes: Nuclide detail snapshots now expose half-life, age-adjusted line intensities, available parent/daughter relationships, specific activity, and one-meter dose context from the active identification source.

steps.title: Implement editable nuclide mixtures in the modern Qt shell
steps.notes: The reference workbench now lets analysts build, normalize, clear, and publish nuclide mixtures as one combined overlay in the modern canvas.

steps.title: Implement direct Log Scale and Peak Labels toggles on the primary canvas
steps.notes: The primary toolbar and View menu now drive log/linear display mode and labeled reference-line visibility directly on the PyQtGraph canvas.
